description: This file defines the SamplingMethodInterceptor class, which implements method interception to enable sampling performance metrics of method executions within the Fineract project. It utilizes Aspect-Oriented Programming (AOP) through the MethodInterceptor interface to wrap method invocations with sampling logic.

classes.name: SamplingMethodInterceptor
classes.description: A method interceptor that wraps method calls to record sampling metrics using SamplingService.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Intercepts method invocation, generates a sampling key based on method name and parameter types, and wraps the invocation with sampling logic.

methods.name: getFormattedArguments
methods.description: Generates a string representation of the method's parameter types for use in the sampling key.
